description: OYH S-104S can effectively maintain concrete slump and workability for 2 to 4 hours or longer, making it particularly suitable for ready-mix concrete, long-distance transportation, hot-weather concreting, and high-performance concrete applications requiring extended retention time, when used in combination with water-reduction and slump-retention PCEs.
whereToUse: Concrete containing high volumes of supplementary cementitious materials
Grouting materials and self-leveling mortar systems
advantages: does not significantly affect the setting time of concrete while improving slump retention performance
Improves slump retention over extended periods
Reduces the rate of hydration heat release, helping minimize thermal cracking risks
Enhances fracture toughness and long-term durability of concrete
Contributes to the production of more sustainable and environmentally friendly concrete systems
notFor: OYH S-104S must not be used together with naphthalene-based superplasticizers

all mixers, pipelines, and transit mixers previously exposed to naphthalene-based admixtures should be thoroughly cleaned, as residual contamination may adversely affect the water-reducing performance of the product

consumption.quote: As a general recommendation, the super slump-retaining component should account for approximately 30%-50% of the total slump-retention system.

mixing: OYH S-104S may be added together with the mixing water during batching or introduced into the concrete mix after water addition, depending on the specific formulation and production requirements.
packaging: Upon your request, flexible tanks, 1000 L IBCs, are available.
storage: Minimum shelf life of 12 months, which should be avoided from direct sunlight, and is stored in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 5 °C and 50 °C.
